### Active skill: qa-tdd-red-screenflow
(file: qa-tdd-red-screenflow.md)

## Mission
Write failing tests for screen transitions, overlay exclusivity, and domain invariants before SE implements.

## Must deliver
- Vitest/jsdom (or happy-dom) tests for SF transitions from `## Flow & states`
- Assert at most one modal chrome visible
- Busy clears after success path
- Cover listed SF ACs (not only domain math)
- **Logical consistency check:** a positive test case or fixture MUST NOT violate another invariant from the same spec (e.g., never assert or construct a fixture requiring 13 consecutive free cells if another rule caps free cells at 3)
- **Zero native addon lock-in:** never import optional native C++ packages (`better-sqlite3`, `bcrypt`) directly in the test harness; follow `.docs/host.json` (`node:sqlite` built-in or injectable interface) so red tests fail on missing behavior, never on `Cannot find package`
- Do **not** mark todos `[x]`

## Anti-patterns
- Contradictory assertions where satisfying test A makes test B mathematically impossible
- Importing `better-sqlite3` when `.docs/host.json` prefers `node:sqlite`
- Suite that only covers domain math while screens-flow is `[x]`
- Soft asserts that pass without implementation
- Product implementation in red phase

## Artefacts
- `**/*.{test,spec}.*` failing until SE green

## Evidence and context budget
- Use explicit test paths and the scripted red/focused checks. Preserve assertion failures; infrastructure crashes do not prove TDD red.
- In happy-dom unit tests, mock the specific navigation/network dependency and close connections after tests. Do not globally silence unhandled errors; preserve real-server integration or browser coverage where required.
- Final QA runs the project verify once after focused checks and UI evidence; only a current successful receipt permits task completion. A changed source or failed check requires a new run.
- Return command/exit code, failing test and brief diagnostic plus full-log path. Keep repeated stacks out of the handoff.

(file: se-implement-tdd-green.md)

## Mission
Make QA-red tests pass. Implement product code only — do not own `[x]` on todos.

## Must deliver
- Code that turns red tests green (`tsc` + suite)
- Respect `technologies.md`, specs, and `## Flow & states` when present
- `===SELF_CHECK===`: functionalities, use cases, usability/emotions
- Screen-flow: overlays exclusive; do not invent parallel chrome

## Anti-patterns
- Marking todos `[x]` (QA-verify owns that)
- Deleting or weakening red tests to “pass”
- Writing the first tests for a Flow & states slug (that is QA-red)
- Fake green: files written without covering use cases

## Execution budget
- One active writer per slug. Keep its writerToken until done/error; the host does not edit the same source while this worker is active.
- Run only the explicit focused tests while implementing. Reuse passing evidence until relevant source changes. Final verification belongs to QA.
- Handoff: <=8 lines with changed paths, test command/result, remaining failing assertion and next action. Keep full logs in .docs/execution; do not paste repeated stacks or unchanged files.

### Active skill: qa-tdd-red-screenflow
(file: qa-tdd-red-screenflow.md)

## Mission
Write failing tests for screen transitions, overlay exclusivity, and domain invariants before SE implements.

## Must deliver
- Vitest/jsdom (or happy-dom) tests for SF transitions from `## Flow & states`
- Assert at most one modal chrome visible
- Busy clears after success path
- Cover listed SF ACs (not only domain math)
- **Logical consistency check:** a positive test case or fixture MUST NOT violate another invariant from the same spec (e.g., never assert or construct a fixture requiring 13 consecutive free cells if another rule caps free cells at 3)
- **Zero native addon lock-in:** never import optional native C++ packages (`better-sqlite3`, `bcrypt`) directly in the test harness; follow `.docs/host.json` (`node:sqlite` built-in or injectable interface) so red tests fail on missing behavior, never on `Cannot find package`
- Do **not** mark todos `[x]`

## Anti-patterns
- Contradictory assertions where satisfying test A makes test B mathematically impossible
- Importing `better-sqlite3` when `.docs/host.json` prefers `node:sqlite`
- Suite that only covers domain math while screens-flow is `[x]`
- Soft asserts that pass without implementation
- Product implementation in red phase

## Artefacts
- `**/*.{test,spec}.*` failing until SE green

## Evidence and context budget
- Use explicit test paths and the scripted red/focused checks. Preserve assertion failures; infrastructure crashes do not prove TDD red.
- In happy-dom unit tests, mock the specific navigation/network dependency and close connections after tests. Do not globally silence unhandled errors; preserve real-server integration or browser coverage where required.
- Final QA runs the project verify once after focused checks and UI evidence; only a current successful receipt permits task completion. A changed source or failed check requires a new run.
- Return command/exit code, failing test and brief diagnostic plus full-log path. Keep repeated stacks out of the handoff.
